description: Hearthblock art (doc 256): cozy square chibi solids. proposal.mjs holds the approved proposal models; tier1.mjs the Tier 1 Axe-Hewn furniture (tools/hearthblock/art; regenerate with write_data.py). Cells use [x0,x1) ranges on the native 1:16 grid. cutbox clips XZ edges, cutbox_x clips YZ, cutbox_z clips XY, paint recolors existing cells, air carves, mirror_x adds a sub-log and its mirror across X=0. Wood roles map to the existing hand_hewn_timber / oak_log source palettes so every wood variant recolors.
